entries.title: Create your own communities
entries.description: You can create a community and switch between your communities from the sidebar.

entries.title: Share posts with your community
entries.description: You can write formatted posts, read your community feed, and see who else has joined.

entries.title: Choose your theme
entries.description: You can choose light, dark, or your device’s theme from your account menu. Your preference is saved to your account.

entries.title: Put your communities in order
entries.description: You can drag communities in the sidebar into the order you prefer.

entries.title: A new welcome page and simpler sign-in
entries.description: You can learn about Orbis on the welcome page and use refreshed forms to register or log in.

entries.title: Retry when your connection drops
entries.description: You now see a connection message and a retry option when your feed, profile, or community details cannot load.
